notes: Imported the completed Do these review workflow from the 78-weapon export.
The first 4.1 review pass reconciles edits made directly inside the review card with live Foundry damage/range fields and FEHA weapon flags.
The four explicit GM notes are applied: Crusher to 5 shells, Igla to 16d2, Liberty to a 4-round magazine with 2 attacks, and Tactician to 5 shells.
Inline review-card edits are honored, including the ForgeLine, Helix, Jade Arc, and Quietus changes from the completed pass.
Previously skipped repaired entries are accepted from their Do these folders even when their names or old profiles differ from the original 81-model seed.
Metel uses the reviewed Tracker rule and Razor Choir uses the reviewed Truesight 30 ft identity.
The mechanical reconciliation is versioned and runs once per weapon; later ADK DEV LOADER runs keep the finalized live mechanics instead of reimporting the review text.
